question: Find drivers born between 1980 and 1990 who have recorded a lap time starting with '1:27' in any race and also have a Q2 qualifying time starting with '1:40' in any (not necessarily the same) race. Return their full name, nationality, date of birth, and introduction website.

prediction.sql: SELECT d."XCL_038" AS forename, d."XCL_039" AS surname, d."XCL_041" AS nationality, d."XCL_040" AS date_of_birth, d."XCL_042" AS introduction_website FROM drivers AS d WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', d."XCL_040") BETWEEN '1980' AND '1990' AND d."XCL_034" IN (SELECT lt."XCL_044" FROM lapTimes AS lt WHERE lt."XCL_047" LIKE '1:27%') AND d."XCL_034" IN (SELECT q."XCL_058" FROM qualifying AS q WHERE q."XCL_063" LIKE '1:40%')

roles.description: Lap time recorded in the first qualifying session (Q1). This is the most frequently populated time column, serving as the baseline for all qualifying entries.
Lap time recorded in the second qualifying session (Q2). This column is populated only for drivers who advanced from Q1, exhibiting a strict subset relationship with Q1 times.
Lap time recorded in the third qualifying session (Q3). This column is populated only for drivers who advanced from Q2, exhibiting a strict subset relationship with Q2 times.

structural_constraints.description: Participation in the second qualifying session (Q2) implies participation in the first qualifying session (Q1). The data confirms this: every row with a Q2 time has a Q1 time, but many rows with a Q1 time do not have a Q2 time.

Participation in the third qualifying session (Q3) implies participation in the second qualifying session (Q2). The data confirms this: every row with a Q3 time has a Q2 time, but many rows with a Q2 time do not have a Q3 time.

eligibility.predicate: EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM lapTimes WHERE lapTimes.XCL_044 = drivers.XCL_034 AND lapTimes.XCL_047 LIKE '1:27%')
EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM qualifying WHERE qualifying.XCL_058 = drivers.XCL_034 AND qualifying.XCL_063 LIKE '1:40%')

arguments.sql:
SELECT d."XCL_038" AS forename, d."XCL_039" AS surname, d."XCL_041" AS nationality, d."XCL_040" AS date_of_birth, d."XCL_042" AS introduction_website
FROM drivers AS d
WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', d."XCL_040") BETWEEN '1980' AND '1990'
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM lapTimes AS lt
    WHERE lt."XCL_044" = d."XCL_034"
      AND lt."XCL_047" LIKE '1:27%'
  )
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM qualifying AS q
    WHERE q."XCL_058" = d."XCL_034"
      AND q."XCL_063" LIKE '1:40%'
  )
